heating_cooling: Heat is the main threat. Plan shade, airflow and water; rest midday; know cooling centers; watch for heat illness.

risks: Drought: supplies can be rationed; store water early.
Flash floods in dry washes; never camp or drive in them.
Arsenic: USGS estimates roughly 22,000 people here use private wells likely above EPA's arsenic limit (2017 model estimate). Boiling does NOT remove arsenic; test private wells.
water.drinking_water_program: Search 'Nevada drinking water program' or ask your water utility; private well guidance: https://www.epa.gov/privatewells
